about: Stop 1 clip A: from edit-gi-glasses-1, the hand picks up the glasses and puts them on, ending on a clean view of the nightstand for clip B.

input.prompt: Soft stylized 3D render, clean CG product-film look, continuing exactly from this frame. First-person point of view: someone who has just woken, lying in bed facing their nightstand in warm morning light. Their own right hand, in a soft plain grey long-sleeved sleep shirt with the cuff at the wrist, enters calmly from the right edge of the frame, picks up the folded black glasses from the nightstand, opens them, and lifts them smoothly up toward the camera, as if putting them on; the glasses pass out of view at the top of the frame. The view then settles, eased slightly higher, on a clear, calm view of the nightstand: the green-lidded nutrilite begin GI primer tub, the glass of water and the lamp, all unchanged. One smooth, steady, gimbal-like movement: no head bob, no shake, no cut. Everything else stays exactly as it is: same room, same soft light, the lamp stays switched off, the tub keeps its shape and label, the drawer stays closed. No person visible, no face, no mirror, no text overlay, nothing appears or disappears except the glasses leaving the nightstand.
